data.description:
## Context
Noolbenger RCA found that a Gerrit object-store repair fetched the stale GitHub mirror directly into Gerrit branch refs (`+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*`), moving `refs/heads/main` backward while Gerrit NoteDb still marked later changes MERGED.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add or update the Gerrit object-store repair runbook to fetch recovery objects into a quarantine namespace, never directly into `refs/heads/*`.
- [ ] Include a required pre/post checklist: EBS snapshots, expected old/new main SHAs, reachability of refs/changes, `git fsck --full --connectivity-only`, replication trigger, and merged-reachability check.
- [ ] Add any lightweight script/guard that can reject or warn on a mirror recovery refspec that writes directly to protected branch refs.
- [ ] Link the runbook/guard to the Mirror Guard merged-reachability invariant added during noolbenger.
data.title: Document safe Gerrit object-store repair
